title: PLC+ — foundations (preview)
note: Preview content for the instructors' review. The package format (spec 6.3: lessons in Markdown with front-matter, signing) is plan phase 4.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: Three rungs: one contact for Green, two in series (AND) for Amber, a normally closed contact for Red.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: Red uses a normally open contact, so it lights in Auto instead of Manual.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: Rung 1: Start, or the Motor's own contact in parallel with it (the seal-in), passes power through Stop to the Motor coil. Let go of Start and the seal-in keeps the motor running. Stop is wired normally closed (TRUE until pressed), so the program checks it with a normally open contact: pressing Stop opens it and breaks the circuit.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: Rung 1 has no seal-in contact: the motor runs only while Start is held down.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: Three on-delay timers in a chain, each started by the one before finishing; the last one restarts the first.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: Yellow has nothing to turn it off when red comes on, so the two are on together.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: Two start/stop circuits, one per direction, each stopped by its limit switch and locked out by the other; the down rung also needs the safety eye clear.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: The down rung does not check the safety eye, so the door comes down on whatever is in the doorway.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: Two latched memory tags, Filling and Draining, set and reset by the floats; the valves follow them.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: Without memory, the valves follow the high float alone: the tank chatters around 80 % and never drains.

programs.title: Works
programs.note: The metal sensor latches MetalSeen; the diverter pushes when the photo-eye sees a part and MetalSeen is set; the part leaving the eye resets it.

programs.title: A common mistake
programs.note: The diverter pushes every part that reaches the eye, metal or plastic.
